_comment: Firebase App Distribution release configuration for MedicalVault. Committed template — no secrets or real tester PII belong here. Copy this file to firebase-distribution.local.json (gitignored) and override any field to use real tester emails without risking a commit. Local overrides are shallow-merged on top of this file, key by key.

releaseNotes.template:
Version {version}
• Bug fixes
• Performance improvements
• UI enhancements
releaseNotes._note: Used only when --notes / --notes-file is not supplied. {version} and {buildNumber} placeholders are substituted.
